classification.difficultyReason: Read the marked sides and angles, identify SAS or AAS, and order corresponding vertices. Congruence is supplied, so each part directly applies a taught test without deriving additional facts.

content.prompt: Each pair of triangles is congruent. State the congruence test and name the two triangles with the vertices in correct order.

spec.description: Two triangles side by side with corresponding one-tick and two-tick sides and alpha at the included angle. Decorative blue is replaced by black.

answer.worked: $AB=DE$, $BC=EF$ and $\angle ABC=\angle DEF=\alpha$. The equal angle lies between the marked sides, so $\triangle ABC\equiv\triangle DEF$ by SAS.

spec.description: Differently oriented right triangles with matching marked legs. Decorative blue is replaced by black.
spec.mathematics: XY=MN; YZ=NL; angle XYZ=angle MNL=90 degrees.

answer.worked: $XY=MN$, $YZ=NL$ and $\angle XYZ=\angle MNL=90^\circ$. The right angle is included between the marked sides, so $\triangle XYZ\equiv\triangle MNL$ by SAS.

spec.description: Paired triangles retain beta at S and D, alpha at U and E, and double ticks on ST and DF. Decorative blue is replaced by black.
spec.mathematics: ST=DF; angle TSU=angle FDE=beta; angle SUT=angle DEF=alpha. The marked side is not between the two marked angles.

answer.worked: $\angle TSU=\angle FDE=\beta$, $\angle SUT=\angle DEF=\alpha$ and $ST=DF$. Two corresponding angles and a corresponding side are equal, so $\triangle STU\equiv\triangle DFE$ by AAS.
